TaskDescription: Passive two-deviant auditory oddball with synthesized Mandarin /i/ syllables from a rising-level-falling (T2-T1-T4) tone continuum: token 5 (level tone T1) as frequent standard, tokens 2 (rising, T2; cross-category) and 8 (level, T1; within-category) as infrequent deviants of equal physical distance. Interstimulus interval (onset-onset) 1100 ms with 5% jitter; 500 trials (250 for S6); the patient watched a silent movie (Si et al. 2017).
Instructions: Watch a silent movie; ignore the sounds (passive listening)
InstitutionName: Epilepsy Center, Yuquan Hospital, Tsinghua University

EDFPrefilterField.Description: EDF header prefilter field as released: high-pass 0.1 Hz, no low-pass, 48-52 Hz notch

iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined subdural (surface) electrodes for seizure-focus localisation; channel names are amplifier inputs (Amp<k>-<n>) as released; the mapping to electrode contacts is not documented
